family.title: Family walkie
family.intro: Family walkie-talkie: speak and everyone hears. Quiet mode is allowed except in parent-defined zones (e.g. home).
family.cloudHint: Sign-in lets you talk across devices.
family.localOnlyHint: Local mode — live talk across devices needs a connection.
family.locationPolicy: Location is sent to admins only when requested and approved — not continuously.
family.permissionsHint: Microphone and location are required. Notifications are recommended for admin alerts.
family.permissionsRequired: Grant mic and location before creating or joining.
family.permissionsOk: Permissions ready — you can create or join a family.
family.pttHint: Hold to talk. Release to listen.
family.quietBlocked: In a forced-audio zone (e.g. home) quiet is blocked — you still hear.
family.locationRequestHint: An admin asked to see your location now — once only.
family.zonesHint: Add a zone at your current location (e.g. home). Quiet mode is blocked inside.
family.mapHint: Local view around your position — forced-listen zones (amber) and boundary lines.
family.mapNoGps: No GPS yet — allow location to see the map.
family.linesHint: A line around your current location. When a member crosses it — admin alert.
family.openStandaloneHint: Family Walkie is a separate PWA. Run npm run dev:family or open the deploy URL.
family.introHuman: Talk like a walkie-talkie — everyone hears. Quiet is allowed except in parent-defined zones.
family.accountHint: Sign-in lets you talk across different devices.
family.permissionsHintHuman: Microphone and on-device location are needed. Location is never sent automatically.
family.permMicWhy: Allow the microphone to talk with your family.
family.permGeoWhy: On-device location detects family zones. It is not sent automatically.
family.permNotifyWhy: Recommended so you don’t miss requests and alerts.
family.permBrowserHelp: If no prompt appears, open this site’s browser settings and allow microphone and location.
family.permissionsRequiredHuman: Allow microphone and location before creating or joining.
family.whatNext: What would you like to do?
family.shareCodeHint: Share the code with your family.
family.shareCodeMessage: Join our family on Oki Family with code {{code}}
family.quietBlockedHuman: In this zone the family set that everyone must hear.
family.locationRequestTitleHuman: {{name}} wants to see where you are now
family.locationRequestHintHuman: Location is shared once only — not continuous tracking.
family.mapHintHuman: OpenStreetMap around your position — meetup pins for everyone; listen zones and closed compounds for parents.
family.inZoneBanner: You’re in “{{zone}}” — here you always hear the family.
family.zonesHintHuman: Add a zone at your current location (e.g. home).
family.zonesMemberHint: Only parents define zones and compounds. Meetup pins are available to everyone above.
family.linesHintHuman: A line around your current location. When someone crosses — you get an alert.
family.meetupsHintHuman: Mark a place to meet on the map (e.g. “Gate 12”). Everyone in the family sees the pin.
family.mapTapMeetup: Tap the map to place the meeting point
family.confirmRemoveMeetup: Remove this meeting point from the map?
family.compoundsHintHuman: Draw a closed shape on the map (at least 3 points). Only parents see compounds and get enter/exit alerts. Tap a compound to remove it.
family.confirmRemoveCompound: Remove this compound from the map?
family.mapTapCompound: Tap the map to add corners. Then tap “Close compound”.
family.mapTapCompoundRemove: Tap an existing compound to delete it.
family.mapCompoundProgress: {{count}} points · need at least {{min}}, then close
family.mapTapZone: Tap the map to place the alert zone center
family.mapTapLine: Tap the map for the boundary line start point
family.mapTapLineSecond: Tap again for the line end point

auth.signUpCheckEmail: Signed up — check your confirmation email, then sign in
auth.guestMode: Guest / demo mode — no cloud keys
auth.requireAuthHint: No guest or demo mode — sign in or sign up to continue
auth.emailNotConfirmed: Email not confirmed yet. Check your inbox (and spam) for the confirmation link, or resend.
auth.signInSuccess: Connected to cloud — opening the map
